band_contract.easy: Direct integer-factor substitution and zero lower endpoint; exact special values or retain arctan at an ordinary rational endpoint.
band_contract.moderate: One denominator normalization, integer or radical scale, and a special-value or symmetric interval; show both endpoint conversions.
band_contract.hard: Authored consistent workload: two nonunit coefficients, irrational substitution factor, and two unlike nonzero transformed endpoints. Both inverse values shown; every arcsine endpoint strictly internal.

sampling: Structural case first; independent positive exact coefficient roles. No global source-number substitution. Mathematical task deduplication across a batch.
limits: Finite bounded catalogs; count 1..100 is an input limit, not a guarantee of that many distinct tasks. Explicit exhaustion. Secant easy has a small integer matching-differential catalog.
